title: Dual-Fuel Credit Restoration Card, Residential Electricity Supply
content:
**Rule.** A dual-fuel credit that was missed on a past billing cycle of a Residential Electricity Supply agreement is restored as one dual-fuel credit line for that cycle, provided a Beacon Ridge residential natural gas agreement on the same premise was active on the cycle's start date and the cycle falls within the billing dispute lookback. A restored dual-fuel credit is the credit line for that one missed cycle, and its amount is the restored dual-fuel credit amount for that cycle rather than the bare per-cycle dual-fuel credit of the plan. The credit is posted as a negative amount on the restored cycle's bill line.

**What the rule governs.** One missed cycle gives one restored line, identified by that cycle's billing period start. When the posting is made, the agreement's bill lines carry a dual-fuel credit line for that billing cycle, and the supply charges billed on the agreement are reduced by the amount credited.

| Question | Answer under the rule |
|---|---|
| Two cycles were missed while the gas agreement was active | Each is restored as its own dual-fuel credit line |
| The gas agreement on the premise was not active on the cycle's start date | The cycle is not restored |
| The cycle lies outside the billing dispute lookback | The cycle is not restored |

## Posting action

**Capability.** `post_dual_fuel_credit_18175409` posts one dual-fuel bill credit to a Residential Electricity Supply agreement for one billing cycle. It adds a new credit line of the dual-fuel kind to the agreement's Beacon Ridge bill lines for the billing cycle given, carrying the amount as a negative (credit) value and today's posting date; the restored credit then shows against that cycle in the agreement's bill lines.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool: the care agent unlocks `post_dual_fuel_credit_18175409` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `power_agreement_id` | The residential electricity agreement number that receives the credit, as read from the agreement lookup | Identifier |
| `referred_customer_id` | The customer number of a referred customer named on the line; a dual-fuel credit is not a referral credit and names no referred customer | Always the empty string "" |
| `billing_period_start` | The first day of the billing cycle the credit belongs to | Calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD |
| `credit_amount_usd` | The size of the credit | Positive amount in USD, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent; the line stores it signed as a negative credit |

**Return.** A confirmation sentence naming the new bill line number, the agreement, the cycle start date and the credited amount in USD. Receiving it means the dual-fuel credit now stands on the bill.

Illustration (hypothetical values): agreement number, an empty `referred_customer_id`, `billing_period_start` 2025-11-04 and `credit_amount_usd` 4.10 produce a dual-fuel credit line of minus 4.10 USD against the cycle starting 2025-11-04.
